[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] '''Sarek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His influence mainly extended over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], as he was the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] tasked with the annexation of the world into the empire.<ref name="TOR:AIF" />
